answer: Registration binds each public key to a Wesolowski VDF seeded by the latest summit beacon, a hash of the previous epoch's top 64 validator signatures. The agent grinds 2^36 sequential squarings, about 6 core-hours, then posts the proof to the Lotus registry, where verifiers check it in 40 ms. Rewards unlock after a 5 token bond clears. A swarm of 10,000 identities needs 60,000 core-hours, about $2,400 in rented compute plus 50,000 bonded tokens, and stale seeds expire each epoch. An open meadow of cloud cores adds no speed, since ten thousand hands cannot wind one clock spring faster.
